source: NIST-JANAF Thermochemical Tables, fourth edition (M. W. Chase, Jr., J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data, Monograph 9, 1998), as served by https://janaf.nist.gov/: tables H-064 (H2O), C-095 (CO2), H-050 (H2), N-023 (N2); rows copied on 2026-09-12 with the tables' precision (three decimals). Standard state 1 bar; R = 8.314510 J/(mol K).
toleranceNote: relativeTolerance bounds |fit - table| / |table| for every column of the species. The NASA Glenn records are fits to compilations other than JANAF (the record comments name the source), and the compilations differ from JANAF by more than the fits' own accuracy; the worst deviation observed on 2026-09-12 is recorded per species so that the check stays a plausibility check of the formulas and units.
